title: Thai style Buddhist calendar support
line: The Digital Clock's alternate calendars now include the Thai solar calendar, showing dates with Buddhist Era years.
explanation: The alternate calendar plugin offers Julian, Chinese, Indian, Hebrew, Islamic, Vietnamese, Ethiopian and other calendars, but not the Thai solar calendar, which Thailand uses officially: the same days and months as the Gregorian calendar, with the year counted in the Buddhist Era (CE + 543). The change adds a "Thai Solar Calendar" entry backed by ICU's Buddhist calendar, built like the existing Indian calendar provider, so the clock popup shows e.g. "24 November, 2569" in its header and day tooltips.

commits.message:
plasmacalendarplugins/alternatecalendar: add Thai solar calendar

The alternate calendar plugin had no way to show the Thai solar calendar,
which is the Gregorian calendar with years counted in the Buddhist Era.
This adds it to the list, using ICU's Buddhist calendar for the dates.

BUG: 502345

media.caption: Master: the calendar system list ends at Bikram Sambat, no Thai calendar
With the fix: "Thai Solar Calendar" is in the list
Master: the clock popup has no way to show a Buddhist Era date
Thai Solar Calendar selected: header and day tooltip show 24 November, 2569 (2026 + 543)
